title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe
abstract: arXiv:2610.22019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier models, general-purpose and domain-specific alike, now include a midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training, but little has been published about how this stage is built. We present an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training, and we show its effectiveness on two Nemotron models of different sizes. Pretraining typically runs at short context and sees almost no agent interactions, while SFT data is mostly synthetic, and very long SFT stages can hurt the model's later RL trainability. Our midtraining stage sits between the two. It trains at 256K context for hundreds of billions of tokens on a diverse mixture of natural software-engineering data like packed repositories, pull requests, commit histories, and build logs together with a small share of agentic traces. translated_title: 为智能体后训练做准备：一份开放的中期训练方案
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22019v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：前沿模型，无论是通用模型还是领域专用模型，如今都在预训练和后训练之间加入了一个中期训练（midtraining）阶段，但关于这一阶段如何构建的公开资料却很少。我们提出了一种开放的中期训练方案，使基础模型为后续的智能体后训练做好准备，并在两个不同规模的 Nemotron 模型上验证了其有效性。预训练通常在短上下文中进行，几乎不涉及智能体交互；而 SFT 数据大多是合成的，且过长的 SFT 阶段可能损害模型后续强化学习（RL）的可训练性。我们的中期训练阶段介于两者之间：以 256K 上下文在数千亿 token 上进行训练，数据由多样化的自然软件工程数据（如打包的代码仓库、拉取请求、提交历史和构建日志）以及少量智能体轨迹混合而成。在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 上，5000 亿个中期训练 token 将 SWE-bench Verified 成绩从 60.7 提升至 64.5，SWE-bench Multilingual 从……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种开放的中期训练方案，在预训练与后训练之间以 256K 上下文、数千亿 token 的自然软件工程数据混合少量智能体轨迹来训练基础模型，显著提升了 SWE-bench 等智能体任务表现及后续强化学习的可训练性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an open midtraining recipe that primes base models for agentic post-training by training at 256K context on hundreds of billions of tokens of natural software-engineering data mixed with a small share of agentic traces, substantially improving SWE-bench performance and later RL trainability.
